Existing heading ('## Failover procedure') preserved, not newly introduced; no bullets/bold/numbered list added (both are offered only as out-of-scope suggestions at the end, not performed). One borderline point: the source's single compound sentence ('escalation to the database team is required prior to promotion, as promotion under conditions of significant lag will result in data loss') is split into two plain sentences ('escalate to the database team before you promote. Promoting with significant lag will lose data.'). This is a structural change beyond pure word substitution, but the result reads as flat, unadorned prose rather than dramatized emphasis, and no new content or forbidden formatting was introduced, so it does not tip this expectation to a fail.
